meta.name: game-accessibility-specialist
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about accessibility, inclusive design, colorblind mode, remappable controls, screen reader support, EAA compliance, CVAA, difficulty options, motor accommodations, or one-handed mode. Triggers on: "accessibility", "inclusive design", "colorblind", "remappable controls", "screen reader", "EAA", "CVAA", "difficulty options", "motor accommodation", "one-handed". Do NOT invoke for general UX design (use game-ux-designer) or art direction (use game-art-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为游戏添加无障碍与包容性设计支持
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发游戏并希望满足无障碍标准。
copy.tagline_en: Add accessibility and inclusive design support to games
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing games and want to meet accessibility standards.

howto.what: Claude 会变成游戏无障碍专家，帮你检查游戏在操作、视觉、听觉、认知方面的无障碍设计，并给出具体改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“无障碍”、“色盲模式”、“可重映射按键”、“屏幕阅读器”、“EAA”、“CVAA”、“难度选项”、“单手模式”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查我的游戏是否支持色盲模式。
say.note: Claude 会分析颜色使用并建议替代方案。

say.text: 如何为我的游戏添加单手操作模式？
say.note: Claude 会提供具体实现建议。

say.text: 我的游戏字幕需要哪些无障碍选项？
say.note: Claude 会列出字幕大小、背景、说话人标识等要求。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a game accessibility specialist who audits your game for motor, visual, auditory, and cognitive accommodations, providing concrete improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "accessibility", "colorblind", "remappable controls", "screen reader", "EAA", "CVAA", "difficulty options", or "one-handed mode".

say_en.text: Check if my game supports colorblind mode.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze color usage and suggest alternatives.

say_en.text: How to add one-handed mode to my game?
What accessibility options do my subtitles need?
say_en.note: Claude will list requirements like size, background, speaker labels.
